title: What DEV Series Are You Reading or Writing? Let’s Make Them Easier to Find
why_read: A community discussion thread asking Dev.to users to share ongoing article series for discoverability, with no technical content of its own.
analysis: This is a meta community post on Dev.to, inviting users to list their ongoing or completed article series in the comments to improve discoverability on the platform. It's purely a community management and content curation exercise, with zero technical substance about software engineering. It might be useful for a Dev.to community manager but has no place in a technical digest for engineers. The engagement numbers are modest and consistent with a niche community housekeeping post.
